phone.notes: Tap a Digimon on the farm to pet, praise or scold it, and they chat by themselves. Digimon World DS farm goods: new pictures for the objects and three type goods (Fire ring, Ball, Birdhouse) that raise the experience of the farm. Accessible mode in Settings: the tamer level grows with the experience of your Digimon instead of steps. A new look for the Digimon popups and a description of each Digimon in the Dex (the first cards for now). Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Wild Digimon now appear after a few hundred steps, not a few dozen: each step has a 0.1% chance, and steps taken while asleep or during a pending meeting no longer count.
